primary_sources.title: Automated deep learning by recurrent hyperparameter optimization

verdict.summary: Rocket's ImageNet subset-size and reward-standard-deviation claims are supported. However, the 0.2/0.1 adequacy thresholds are empirical diagnostics for Rocket's normalized reward dynamics, not a general proxy-validity or rank-preservation theorem. The paper asserts rank consistency and shows positive subset/full performance correlation, but reports no Pearson/Spearman rank coefficient and the enumerated public data releases do not list raw ImageNet per-configuration subset-versus-full paired ranks. The up-to-80x claim is a separate ResNet-18/ImageNet compute-cost example, not the same ViT-t subset-size ablation and not a direct wall-clock speedup measurement.

verified_claims.claim: Across 30 independent Rocket experiments the average normalized reward standard deviation lies roughly in [0.2, 0.6], with decline above 0.1 across those runs.
verified_claims.scope: Rocket experiments and Rocket-normalized reward only

verified_claims.claim: ViT-t/ImageNet subset ratios 1/1024, 1/512, 1/256, 1/128 yield subset performance 1.47, 2.48, 6.31, 13.37 and final fullset performance 65.23, 71.09, 73.47, 75.34.
Default diagnostic thresholds are 0.2 for early reward std and 0.1 for subsequent decline.
verified_claims.scope: Empirical Rocket diagnostics; not universal constants and not a direct rank-correlation guarantee

verified_claims.claim: Reward computation is accelerated by up to about 80x with data splitting.
verified_claims.evidence: Main paper gives about 9.7e2 EFLOPs without split versus 1.2e1 EFLOPs with split for ResNet-18/ImageNet, about 80.8x.
verified_claims.scope: Compute-cost reduction example on ResNet-18/ImageNet; not direct end-to-end wall-clock acceleration and not the ViT-t subset-size ablation

verified_claims.claim: Full-dataset evaluation is deferred to the final evaluation in the large-dataset reward-approximation strategy.

scope_corrections: Do not use Rocket's 0.2/0.1 values as general scientist-agent proxy-validity thresholds.
Do not combine the ViT-t/ImageNet subset-size ablation and the ResNet-18/ImageNet approximately-80x EFLOPs comparison as one matched experiment.

The paper's rank-consistency claim is supported by qualitative/high-positive subset/full correlation plots, including Figure 7 on ResNet-18/CIFAR-100 and YOLOv5/VOC, but no numeric Pearson/Spearman rank coefficient is reported for the ImageNet subset-size experiment.
A cheap subset being executable is not an adequacy test: 1/1024 remains functional yet ends at 65.23 fullset accuracy versus 75.34 at 1/128.

explicitly_listed_releases.complete_training_records: four rounds on miniCIFAR with ResNet-18

artifact_reproducibility.transport_limit: The Figshare source-code landing page was inspected, but binary archive retrieval redirected to a short-lived S3 URL blocked by the available browser transport, so archive internals were not searched in this run.
artifact_reproducibility.license_metadata_note: Nature states Apache License 2.0 for the whole project while the Figshare source-code landing page displays CC BY 4.0. Archive-internal licensing was not inspected, so this is a metadata ambiguity, not a definitive conflict.

downstream_use.supported: Use an adaptive fidelity controller that monitors a domain-specific discriminative signal and escalates fidelity when the cheap proxy stops guiding search, with final full-fidelity admission.
downstream_use.unsupported: Do not claim direct rank preservation or reuse Rocket's numeric thresholds outside Rocket without a matched domain-specific proxy/full-fidelity validation.
